Chapter 1330: 13: Successors Will Always Come

Chapter 1330: Chapter 13: Successors Will Always Come

According to Lin Yuan’s current understanding of the Thirteen-stage Time Beings, this tier is divided into the First Realm, Second Realm, and Third Realm.

Among them, the Third Realm is the epitome of the Thirteen-stage pinnacle, also known as the Time Lord.

Currently, Lin Yuan’s strength should be considered quite strong among the Thirteen-stage First Realm Time Beings.

Of course, the ‘quite strong’ mentioned here purely refers to combat power and offensive capabilities.

In fact, the strongest means of Time Beings is still the observation of future timelines.

The more powerful a Time Being is, the more timelines they can observe, mastering more future possibilities.

At the same time, the future timelines they observe are farther, allowing them to plan and strategize in advance.

In terms of observing future timelines, Lin Yuan should only be considered an ordinary Time Being at this time.

After all, his life’s essence has not reached the Thirteen-stage level, and his ability to observe future timelines relies on the inheritance left by the Lord of Heaven Light.

As well as the blessing of the lordly status.

Especially the latter.

When Lin Yuan fully steps into the Thirteen-stage and becomes a Time Being.

The true role of the lordly status will be revealed.

The lordly status does not directly enhance strength.

It mainly enhances the mastery of timelines.

With the blessing of the Third Realm lordly status, as long as Lin Yuan becomes a Time Being.

In terms of observing and peering into future timelines, if not stepping directly into the lord level, he would at least be at the Second Realm height.

And the Thirteen-stage Second Realm…For Time Beings to advance their strength and realm is extremely difficult, from the birth to the great destruction of a dimensional space, the strongest Time Beings mostly halt at the First Realm.

Time Lords of the Second Realm, and even the Third Realm, generally enter the dimension gaps for long epochs, with their home dimensions having already undergone countless great destructions.

The Lord of Heaven Light, as a Time Lord, was not born of this source world’s great catastrophe but was an outsider, attempting to leverage the unique perfect breath of the source world to impact the Fourteenth Stage.

“A stronger Time Being in the First Realm of the Thirteen-stage?”

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied, as other Time Beings require an entire great destruction cycle to hope to reach this level.

But how long has Lin Yuan been cultivating?

And most importantly.

Lin Yuan has not yet stepped into the Thirteen-stage.

He is not a Time Being.

“In the Chaos Void, Time Beings able to rival me probably include only three or four like Lord Mo Xu; the First Source World only has the Da Fu Ancestor and Da Ling Ancestor, but this source world? No more than six.”

Lin Yuan has a precise understanding of his strength.

If he smoothly steps into the Thirteen-stage, his strength will skyrocket.

…

“With my current strength, I could completely end the magic disaster early.”

Lin Yuan looked at the world full of boundless Demonic Qi and shook his head slightly, “But there’s no need.”

Even with Lin Yuan’s current strength, eradicating the magic disaster would consume a great amount of time, millions? Billions of years wouldn’t be enough.

In fact, for Time Beings, millions or billions of years is not long, but in Lin Yuan’s heart, it’s incredibly lengthy.

Rather than that, it would be better to wait until he steps into the Thirteen-stage, becomes a Time Being, and after his strength undergoes another qualitative transformation, to then bring an end to it.

By then, with Lin Yuan’s strength, the time to eradicate the magic disaster will be much shorter, maybe a few decades would suffice.

While the Demon God may be the true form of a Third Realm lord, the true lord ultimately fell, and relying merely on the instincts of its true form, it can only trouble some First Realm Time Beings.

…

Beyond the Source World.

Thirteen Eternal Lords watched the scenes flashing in the image with complicated expressions.

As powerful as the Demon God was, in the face of a ‘Galaxy’ that was not even a Time Being yet, it actually dispersed its demonic body, merging into the world’s Demonic Qi to hide.

The Demon God, as the black demonic form of the Lord of Heaven Light, had no mental will, unable to wield truly powerful secret techniques, and most of the Demonic Qi was scattered in every corner of the world.

Even so, it still rivaled a normal First Realm Time Being, but before Lin Yuan, it was suppressed.

“Galaxy…”

The Master of Infinite had a dazed expression, as if vaguely returning to long before when the magic disaster had not emerged, and the Lord of Heaven Light, whom he revered most, was still alive.

On that day, the Lord of Heaven Light summoned them, the thirteen Eternal Lords.

Bathed in infinite light, the thirteen Eternal Lords felt like they were soaking in hot springs, indescribably comfortable, looking at the majestic figure before them with curious expressions.

Why did the Lord of Heaven Light take the initiative to gather them?

Eternal Lords can observe future timelines, but when it involves Third Realm lords, the information they can observe is extremely limited.

“Today, I plan to attempt perfection.”

The Lord of Heaven Light’s gaze was gentle, smiling as he spoke to the thirteen Eternal Lords.

“Attempting perfection?”

The Master of Infinite was shocked, knowing what attempting to become a Perfect Time Being entails.

A lord of the Third Realm can gather their past, present, and future timelines completely to choose to attempt perfection.

Perfection… In different Time Being understandings, it has different terms, like the Lord of Heaven Light prefers to substitute ‘Omnipotent’ for perfection.

The ultimate pursuit of the Lord of Heaven Light is omnipotence, to achieve ‘omnipotence’ through runes, to ascend to perfection through runes.

However.

When a Time Lord attempts perfection, there are only two possibilities.

One is success, becoming an omnipotent Perfect Time Being.

The second is failure, resulting in ultimate demise, no matter how many survival measures this Time Lord has.

Once the attempt to become a Perfect Time Being fails, death is certain, and no one can save them.
